agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: A high Energy Ball roll fainted Ohmnomnom after one Metal Claw; the Cufant party then suffered five status-prevented turns and all six members fainted before Eelektrik.

resolution.observed: Current forward RAM now contains full-health Bugatti instead of Cufant. Bugatti outspeeds Sunflora, resists Grass and Poison attacks, carries super-effective Poison Tail plus Protect, and the strategy ledger contains two authoritative 23-action Gavi wins for this pairing.

findings.why_bad: Cufant did not provide a reliable answer to GrassWhistle and consumed the resources needed for Eelektrik.
findings.improvement: Retire the historical Cufant opening and qualify only the current Bugatti team from a new forward checkpoint.
findings.next_test: Create a new precontact checkpoint from the verified Bugatti party and restart qualification at clone 1.

findings.summary: The Sunflora line relayed status from forced Bushtank to Coppertop and back, producing attacks only after multiple sleep-prevented turns.

resolution.observed: The current profile now forces Bugatti after the Sunflora handoff and commits Poison Tail without another switch; the passive Bushtank-Cufant pairing is absent from the prepared party.

findings.why_bad: Safe-switch scoring could not solve repeated sleep when neither replacement was a true matchup counter.
findings.improvement: Bind the proven Bugatti role as the dedicated Sunflora finisher and forbid voluntary switching while it attacks.
findings.next_test: Reject any clone where Bugatti enters Sunflora and leaves without first producing damage.

findings.summary: The reusable strategy vetoed Croakatoa Fake Out even on a fresh forced entry, discarding a legitimate free flinch.
findings.improvement: The veto now applies only when fresh_entry is false; a regression confirms fresh Fake Out remains legal and stale Fake Out is vetoed.
findings.next_test: Use Fake Out only when the reconstructed transaction history proves a fresh entry.

findings.summary: Lildozer and Birdlaw fainted after making verified Ponyta and Dustox progress; later losses were caused by the failed Sunflora preparation rather than those sacrifices.
findings.next_test: Retain the early line only if Bugatti reaches Sunflora healthy.

findings.summary: The loss consumed 29 actions, including five status-prevented actions; the Bugatti line should remove that stall.
findings.next_test: Compare status-prevented actions and total switches in the first Bugatti clone.

correct_choices: Actions 1-13 made verified direct progress through Bibarel, Ponyta, and Dustox without a switch reversal.
Turns 7, 12, 15, 21, and 25 were forced replacements after faints; they were not voluntary switch spam.
The terminal whiteout was detected authoritatively even though the game auto-healed the party afterward.
agent_review.next_test: The loss resets qualification to clone 1. Build the new Route 110 Bugatti opening and do not enter the live fight.
